prompt_meta.title: Domain Foundation (GA-grade): Sports catalog + User Profile + Preferences + Onboarding capture + (optional) device tokens

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0004 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve default sports list for Korea launch wedge (IDE proposes list; you approve/reject).

step_objectives.goal: Create the foundational domain models and UX for sports + user profile + preferences that all future features (games, venues, clubs, achievements) will depend on, with GA-quality validation and tests.
outcomes: User profile exists and editable (localized UI web+mobile)
User preferences exist and editable (sports selection + skill/level + location area + availability basics)
Post-signup onboarding captures minimum required setup before user can proceed
Optional foundation: device tokens + notification preferences persisted (no sending yet)
constraints: IDE chooses how to represent sports, skill levels, availability, and location (must be simple and extendable).
No real map integration required yet; store user-selected home area and preferred radius in a simple, privacy-safe way.
No booking, payments, chat, partner portal, or matchmaking algorithms in this step.
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running (auto-start if needed) and API can access DB/cache
API endpoints exist for: sports catalog, profile, preferences, onboarding completion state
Web and Mobile have localized screens to view/edit profile + preferences and complete onboarding
Automated tests pass for API + Web + Mobile for the above
Manifest updated and STEP report produced

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Keep automation consistent: infra must be running for DB-backed models.
requirements: Detect OS and ensure Docker daemon is running (auto-start/install attempts as needed).
Bring up infra via docker compose if not already running.
Ensure API has correct env/config to connect and run migrations.
acceptance_criteria: API can read/write DB during tests

deliverables_outcomes.goal: A canonical sports list (extensible) used by both Web and Mobile.
requirements: Persist sports catalog in DB (or a documented equivalent) and provide an API to list and fetch details.
Seed an initial default list appropriate for Korea (IDE proposes).
Expose localized labels for sports (KO/EN) via the app's i18n approach.
acceptance_criteria: Sports list endpoint returns stable IDs and localized display labels
Tests validate catalog retrieval and seed idempotency

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Editable profile foundation for identity and future social features.
requirements: Profile fields must include at minimum: displayName, locale, timezone, and at least one public-facing profile attribute (IDE chooses; must be safe and optional).
Profile must be retrievable and updatable for authenticated users.
Input validation and safe defaults must exist.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover: get profile, update profile, invalid payload rejection
Web+Mobile screens allow viewing and editing profile with localized labels

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Capture preferences needed to power discovery later.
requirements: Preferences must include at minimum: selected sports (with per-sport level/skill), home area (coarse), preferred radius, and basic availability (simple representation).
Preferences must be retrievable and updatable for authenticated users.
Preferences must be linked to onboarding completion.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover: set/get preferences and validation for sports IDs/levels
Onboarding completion toggles only when minimum required preferences exist

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Prevent a half-configured account from entering the product.
requirements: Define a minimum onboarding requirement set (e.g., accept policies already exists; now also require sports selection + home area).
Expose an API for onboarding status and enforce gating on protected UI routes/screens.
Web+Mobile must route user to onboarding until completed.
acceptance_criteria: Automated test: new user cannot access main app area until onboarding complete
Automated test: after completing onboarding, access is allowed

deliverables_outcomes.area: Optional: device tokens + notification preferences (no sending)
deliverables_outcomes.goal: Prepare for push/email notifications later without implementing notification delivery.
requirements: Persist device token registration per user (platform + token) OR provide a documented reason to defer.
Persist notification preferences (simple structure).
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover create/update/remove device token OR explicit deferral documented in report and ops/DOMAIN_MODEL.md

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Keep GA build predictable and auditable.
requirements: Create ops/DOMAIN_MODEL.md documenting: sports, profile, preferences, onboarding state, and how it will extend to games/venues later.
Create ops/ONBOARDING_REQUIREMENTS.md documenting the minimum required fields and why.
If any tradeoffs exist (e.g., coarse location strategy), document them.
acceptance_criteria: Docs match the implemented behavior and are clear enough for future steps

tasks.name: Ensure infra is running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Start Docker/infra automatically and confirm DB connectivity.
acceptance: docker + infra running OR BLOCKED with exact OS/permission limitation

tasks.name: Implement sports catalog + seed
tasks.objective: Create persistent sports list with localized labels and stable IDs.

tasks.name: Implement profile + preferences APIs
tasks.objective: Authenticated endpoints for profile/preferences with validation and tests.

tasks.name: Web + Mobile onboarding + settings UX (localized)
tasks.objective: Screens for onboarding, profile, preferences; gating enforced.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce report.

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0004.report.json with no placeholders.
